statement: Capture-recorded Puck Steam-stopped and active sessions included 0x43 at 15 wire bytes (14 body); 2–3 reports per ten-second stopped window. This matches Linux/SDL source-only 0x43 battery-status wire length, but its physical payload fields, values, and charging cadence are unverified.

applicability.revision: operator notes: July–August 2026; hardware revision unrecorded
applicability.scope: Notes §6–8, source-only 0x43 agreement not physical battery decoding.
